description: This file is a test script for Git's submodule cloning functionality, including tests for various clone options like --no-remote-submodules, --remote-submodules, --single-branch, and --filter. It sets up repositories, performs clone operations with different parameters, and asserts expected behaviors.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the current repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, runs the commands, and checks for success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test case.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares the configuration value of a given key in a specified repository.

methods.name: test_cfg_global
methods.description: Sets or gets global configuration values for testing.
